sn35.89:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Bāhiyo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || la || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Bāhiyo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.89:1.2: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || yam aham Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pāhitatto vihareyyan ti || || 4-8
sn35.89:4.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukkaṃ vāti || ||
sn35.89:6.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn35.89:6.2: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || ||
sn35.89:9.4: idam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukham vā || tam pi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti || ||
sn35.89:11.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti || ||
sn35.89:13.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ kallan nu tam anupassituṃ
sn35.89:13.2: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || ||
sn35.89:15.1: Evam passaṃ Bāhiya sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmim pi || rūpesu pi || cakkhuviññāṇe pi || cakkhusamphasse pi || pe ||
sn35.89:15.2: yampidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukkhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tasmim pi nibbindati ||
sn35.89:15.3: nibbindaṃ virajjati || virāgā vimuccati || Vimuttasmim pī vimuttam iti ñāṇaṃ hoti || ||
sn35.89:15.4: Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || 11
sn35.89:16.1: Atha kho āyasmā Bāhiyo Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi || || 12
sn35.89:16.2: Atha kho āyasmā Bāhiyo eko vupakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajanti || tadanuttaram brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññāya sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi || ||
sn35.89:16.3: Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyam kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi || || 13
sn35.89:16.4: Aññataro ca panāyasmā Bāhiyo arahataṃ ahosīti || || 2
